S.FORM: == 部落概況與位置 == qalang na tranan ga,kki'an na squliq Tayal,smsun squ gaga ru pincbaqan na qnxan Tayal,ini iyal wahiy pcyaqih na pmrruw zyuwaw kbalyun ,nanu qu rhizyal qyunam,inkyasan hlahuy ga mtasaw kinbalay betunux ,giwal nqu qqalang betunux minnanak iyat hmtan pkton na rhzyal.yasa qu tepucig min'zyu be thaqan na qalanq,maki sa yatux balau qu dong mstranan,maki hazi 106.3188 mpayat hkuy kore kinslabang nya ru 600 meta kinwagiq nya spngan kahul babaw bsilung umi',spiyang zzik na qalanq Ulay. Pinqzwan nqu mrhuw ta Yawi.Puna' ga,kahl kinhulan lkotas ta pinsbkan, ru magan squ kinqoyat biniq na Lkbuta lru rasun nya kwara cingasal nya si pkrayas squ hlahuy ,mintehuk squ qalang mstranan qani ,qsu'un nya psurux qalang beh gong cyaqung qasa, yasa qu qsu balay maki qalang beh yatux na llyung mstranan la,,baqaw ta kawas 1730 hazi mwah min'izyu sqani.suruw ryax nasa ga, ktan nha talagay pizyux qqulih Tayal si qopu' mutu' babaw na qsya llyung ru cingay bal qsinuw nyux mhmut mlata' mqyanux beh syaw gong ru rrgyax,pqasun balay inlungan nya mrhu Yawi.Puna' ini naga kzinga nya musa kmayal mrhu krahu kinholan nqu Lkbuta,pqutan nya Yawi.Puna' qenu qasa ? nanu lalu na? si knguray mnglung kma qu Yawi.Puna' mha: trang ryax nasa ga …..trang …ini nya baqi lalu nya ,iyat nya pnongan ana qutux uzi, nanu yasa si piray hmali nya mrhu Lkbuta' mha: mstranan ,twangan nya an suruw trang lga lalu na Tayal" tranan " mha la,ana musa qalang inu qalang Tayal ga ,pqzyu' squ qalang mtranan ga misuw bal llungun nha rhzyal na hbuyaw qquliq Tayal ru qsinuw nhyun nqu mblaq qqoyat na qalang ,mwah squ tlelu mlahang lga "xusan song"son nha la, ana betaq soni qu lalu na qalang la. 相傳始祖亞維.布納(Yawi.Puna') (Lkbuta')的祝福, (Lkbuta') (Lkbuta') (Yawi.Puna') (mtrang) (mtrang…)的泰雅族語加上an變成處所的名詞(mstranan), mstranan部落就想起亞維.布納(Yawi.Puna') .
S.PHON: ******* qalaŋ na tranan ɣakkiʔan na [s|ɕ]quliq tajal[s|ɕ]m[s|ɕ]un [s|ɕ]qu ɣaɣa ru pin[ʦ|ʨ]βaqan na qnxan tajalini ijal waħij p[ʦ|ʨ]jaqiħ na pmrruw zjuwaw kβaljun nanu qu rħizjal qjunaminkja[s|ɕ]an ħlaħuj ɣa mta[s|ɕ]aw kinβalaj βetunux ɣiwal nqu qqalaŋ βetunux minnanak ijat ħmtan pkton na rħzjalja[s|ɕ]a qu tepu[ʦ|ʨ]iɣ minʔzju βe tħaqan na qalanqmaki [s|ɕ]a jatux βalau qu *oŋ m[s|ɕ]trananmaki ħazi ******* mpajat ħkuj kore kin[s|ɕ]laβaŋ nja ru *** meta kinwaɣiq nja [s|ɕ]pŋan kaħul βaβaw β[s|ɕ]iluŋ umiʔ[s|ɕ]pijaŋ zzik na qalanq ulaj pinqzwan nqu mrħuw ta jawipunaʔ ɣakaħl kinħulan lkota[s|ɕ] ta pin[s|ɕ]βkan ru maɣan [s|ɕ]qu kinqojat βiniq na lkβuta lru ra[s|ɕ]un nja kwara [ʦ|ʨ]iŋa[s|ɕ]al nja [s|ɕ]i pkraja[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu ħlaħuj minteħuk [s|ɕ]qu qalaŋ m[s|ɕ]tranan qani q[s|ɕ]uʔun nja p[s|ɕ]urux qalaŋ βeħ ɣoŋ [ʦ|ʨ]jaquŋ qa[s|ɕ]a ja[s|ɕ]a qu q[s|ɕ]u βalaj maki qalaŋ βeħ jatux na lljuŋ m[s|ɕ]tranan laβaqaw ta kawa[s|ɕ] **** ħazi mwaħ minʔizju [s|ɕ]qani[s|ɕ]uruw rjax na[s|ɕ]a ɣa ktan nħa talaɣaj pizjux qquliħ tajal [s|ɕ]i qopuʔ mutuʔ βaβaw na q[s|ɕ]ja lljuŋ ru [ʦ|ʨ]iŋaj βal q[s|ɕ]inuw njux mħmut mlataʔ mqjanux βeħ [s|ɕ]jaw ɣoŋ ru rrɣjaxpqa[s|ɕ]un βalaj inluŋan nja mrħu jawipunaʔ ini naɣa kziŋa nja mu[s|ɕ]a kmajal mrħu kraħu kinħolan nqu lkβutapqutan nja jawipunaʔ qenu qa[s|ɕ]a nanu lalu na [s|ɕ]i kŋuraj mŋluŋ kma qu jawipunaʔ mħa traŋ rjax na[s|ɕ]a ɣa traŋ ini nja βaqi lalu nja ijat nja pnoŋan ana qutux uzi nanu ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]i piraj ħmali nja mrħu lkβutaʔ mħa m[s|ɕ]tranan twaŋan nja an [s|ɕ]uruw traŋ lɣa lalu na tajal tranan mħa laana mu[s|ɕ]a qalaŋ inu qalaŋ tajal ɣa pqzjuʔ [s|ɕ]qu qalaŋ mtranan ɣa mi[s|ɕ]uw βal lluŋun nħa rħzjal na ħβujaw qquliq tajal ru q[s|ɕ]inuw nħjun nqu mβlaq qqojat na qalaŋ mwaħ [s|ɕ]qu tlelu mlaħaŋ lɣa xu[s|ɕ]an [s|ɕ]oŋ[s|ɕ]on nħa la ana βetaq [s|ɕ]oni qu lalu na qalaŋ la ********jawipunaʔ lkβutaʔ*** lkβutaʔ lkβutaʔ jawipunaʔ mtraŋ mtraŋ*******an*******m[s|ɕ]tranan m[s|ɕ]tranan*********jawipunaʔ
